description: Lorentz factor gamma = E/m_mu and laboratory lifetime tau_lab = gamma tau_mu at E_mu = 1 TeV; passing proves the derived lifetime records are consistent with PDG constants and with the 'approximately 20 ms' quoted by the muLHC paper.
